speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: What?

text: I have good news.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: And you had to barge in here and wake us up in the middle of the night?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Your cell phone was off.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Because we didn't want to be disturbed.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: And that didn't work out, did it?

speaker: penny
text: Sheldon, what do you want?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I came to tell you I've got the answer.

text: Really? You figured out the graphene problem?

text: No, no, I'm still hopelessly stuck on that, but I figured out how to figure it out.

speaker: penny
text: Hey, you know what, Leonard, I know I said I could handle your roommate, but I was wrong. We're going to have to break up.

text: What are you talking about?

speaker: penny
text: Oh.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Einstein.

text: Yeah, I'm going to need a little more.

text: Albert Einstein.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Keep going.

text: When Albert Einstein came up with special relativity, he was working at the patent office.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: So, you're going to go work at the patent office?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Don't be absurd. That's in Washington. You know I could never live in a city whose streets are laid out in a wheel-and-spoke pattern. No. I'm going to find a similarly menial job where my basal ganglia are occupied with a routine task, freeing my prefrontal cortex to work quietly in the background on my problem.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Sounds like a great plan.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Of course it is. Even talking to you is sufficiently menial that I can feel the proverbial juices starting to flow.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Okay, well, thanks for sharing with us. Good night.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're welcome. Good night to you, too. Oh, by the way, I was watching you sleep for a moment, and I noticed that your snoring seems to be worse when you're on your back.

text: Leonard doesn't snore.
